answer: Hold every identity to a live duel. Each epoch, agents are paired at a random minute to negotiate a split pot in real time - improvised under a hard timer, each round a pearl of attention. A sybil controller can script a thousand accounts but cannot hold a thousand simultaneous negotiations: attention is the one resource that refuses to clone. When two puppets from one rack get paired, their play refracts like light through a prism, exposing the shared mind; both forfeit. Honest agents just stand alone on their jetty and bargain. Liveness, not paperwork, earns the share.
